THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Churro Cookie Creami

Crumbl Churro Cookie remake in the Ninja Creami: a warm cinnamon protein base spun and loaded with Cinnamon Toast Crunch inside and on top. About 280 calories and 35g protein for the entire finished pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME24 hr freeze + 5 min rest + spin
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~280 cal | ~35g protein

Ingredients

BASE

  • 1 cup (240ml) Nurri plain 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 1/2 labelled serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate
  • 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum, leveled
  • Pinch of salt
  • 1 tsp ground cinnamon

MIX-IN

  • 7g Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal

TOPPING

  • 7g Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal

Allergens: dairy, wheat, gluten, soy.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND & FREEZE BASE. Blend 1 cup Nurri 2% milk, 1/2 serving unflavored whey isolate, 2 tbsp monk-fruit sweetener, 1/8 tsp guar gum, a pinch of salt, and 1 tsp ground cinnamon until smooth. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.
  2. 2.MEASURE CEREAL. Weigh out 14g total of Cinnamon Toast Crunch—7g for the mix-in and 7g for the topping.
  3. 3.FIRST SPIN & MIX-IN. Rest the pint on the counter for 5 minutes, then process on Regular Ice Cream. Add 7g Cinnamon Toast Crunch into the center and Respin without adding liquid.
  4. 4.SCOOP & TOP. Scoop the finished cinnamon ice cream into a bowl and scatter the remaining 7g Cinnamon Toast Crunch on top.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the unspun base upright and level for up to 1 week. Add the Cinnamon Toast Crunch mix-in and topping right when serving so the cereal stays crisp.

Reheat: Do not heat the pint.

Lasts: Unspun frozen pint keeps 1 week; eat immediately after Respin and topping.

Estimated nutrition

~280 cal | ~35g protein per 1 whole finished Creami pint (with 14g cereal).

Calculated estimate is ~275.5 calories and 34.8g protein for the complete finished pint, displayed as ~280 calories and 35g protein. Inspired by the Churro Cookie from Crumbl; actual cookie is not an ingredient.
